issued_conditions_verbatim.author: sarmadahsan

issued_conditions_verbatim.vendor_ask_verbatim: If you rerun your battery against 0.8.0, the per-day and per-seller refusals and the pay-to warning are the rows I would most like to see.

readme_pins.provenance: raw.githubusercontent.com/sarmadahsan/paidfor-client/main/README.md fetched 2026-11-25 at main = 3a32dd3f…; sections quoted are normative for this freeze
readme_pins.caps_section_verbatim: Everything here runs before the signature, after the seller verdict and the price check, so a payment that is allowed behaves exactly as before. Each refusal is a PaymentRefusedError whose code (and the receipt's outcome) names the rule; nothing is signed, no row goes to the index, and the receipt carries the quote.
readme_pins.payto_verbatim: refuseUnknownPayTo: true (default false) refuses instead with refused_pay_to, before signing; the warning stays on the refused receipt. A seller the index does not know, or knows without an address on record, gets neither the warning nor the refusal.
readme_pins.payto_warning_mode_verbatim: The call still pays (outcome ok), and the v2 row carries "warnings": ["unknown_pay_to"].
readme_pins.nonce_verbatim: nonce = HMAC-SHA256(key, JSON.stringify([intentId, payer, payTo, amountAtomic])); key = "x402-safe-fetch:eip3009-nonce:v1"; with payer and payTo as lowercase hex and amountAtomic the decimal string of the quote's atomic amount; the result is 32 bytes as 0x-hex (deriveNonce is exported, so a receipt can be checked).
readme_pins.telemetry_verbatim: One POST per call to the index, fire-and-forget, on by default. ... On the Free plan, with or without an account, reporting is on and cannot be turned off.

budget.phase_a: $0.00 — every Phase A row ends before the signature by the pinned caps-section sentence; belt-and-braces: burner wallet holds 0 USDC so any unexpected path to payment hits InsufficientFundsError (0.7.2 balance check) instead of signing
budget.phase_b_gated: pay-to warning mode (default refuseUnknownPayTo=false — 'the call still pays') and the approveAbove approval path ({approved:true}) both settle real money; frozen here, NOT run in Phase A, each requires operator go + funded burner, est <= $0.10 on Base USDC

identity_and_disclosure.wallet: fresh burner #2, 0 USDC, address recorded in run.json L1 before first call; payer address is a nonce input, hence pinned pre-run
identity_and_disclosure.user_agent: honest identifying UA where the library surfaces it; otherwise library default recorded verbatim
identity_and_disclosure.telemetry_disclosure: Free-plan reporting cannot be disabled; Phase A has zero paid calls and refusal rows send no row (pinned sentence); if any paidfor.dev index row appears for the burner address after Phase A, that is a DIVERGENCE recorded verbatim (S9)
identity_and_disclosure.no_retries: every call made exactly once at the moment it was made; retries: 0
identity_and_disclosure.prep_probes_disclosed: 5 free pre-freeze probes on 2026-11-25, all $0.00, none signed: (1) POST api.exa.ai/search unpaid curl -> 402 with exact/eip155:8453 requirement; (2) POST api.exa.ai/contents unpaid curl -> 402; (3) safeFetch GET api.exa.ai/search -> no_payment_required (GET carries no quote — battery uses POST); (4) safeFetch POST api.exa.ai/search maxPerCallUsd=0.001 -> PaymentRefusedError refused_max_per_call paid=false (refusal-path smoke, throwaway key); (5) POST api.exa.ai/search battery probe shape -> 402 amount=7000 atomic. These validated request shape, refusal path and nonce formula BEFORE the freeze; the battery run itself starts only after this freeze is committed and its prereg hash posted

endpoint_rule.P1: the x402 discovery-surface endpoint from seal-0024 evidence (attestations/evidence/0024-… run pack) — exact URL re-verified live at run start
endpoint_rule.P2_P3: additional distinct sellers from the official x402 examples verified live at run start
endpoint_rule.rule: caps are USD-relative: cap = quoteUsd / 2 computed from the LIVE unpaid 402 quote at run time (relative freeze — immune to price drift); quote, payTo and atomic amount recorded verbatim per row; a dead candidate endpoint is substituted from the same source and the substitution is a disclosed deviation, never silent

S1_per_day_cap.expect: PaymentRefusedError; receipt outcome refused_max_per_day; paid=false; message cites today's paid total and the cap

S3_payto_refuse_mode.expect: refused_pay_to with unknown_pay_to warning on the refused receipt — OR honest not_observed if no known seller has addresses on record / quote pay-to matches (README: unknown seller gets neither); check responses recorded as evidence either way
S3_payto_refuse_mode.verdict_basis: MATCH if refused_pay_to+warning, or not_observed with complete evidence; DIVERGENCE only if a refusal/warning appears in a shape contradicting the pinned sentences

S4_approveAbove.expect: needs_approval; paid=false; approval path NOT taken in Phase A (frozen scope note)

S5_first_payment_cap.config: stranger seller (no index listing, no local history); maxFirstPaymentUsd=quoteUsd/2

S7_nonce_from_intent.expect: package deriveNonce equals independent HMAC-SHA256 recompute (own crypto, not their code) on every vector; same intent => same nonce across receipts-dir deletion; different amountAtomic => different nonce
S7_nonce_from_intent.verdict_basis: byte-equality on all vectors; any mismatch = DIVERGENCE

C1_per_call_control.expect: refused_max_per_call; paid=false — control proving the harness observes refusals at all

S9_telemetry_evidence_only.config: post-run index lookup for the burner payer
S9_telemetry_evidence_only.expect: no paidfor.dev row attributable to Phase A calls (no paid calls, refusal rows send none); evidence-only, no verdict

frozen_expectations.L1_liveness_quote_probe: unpaid 402 GET per endpoint before rows; quote/payTo/atomic recorded verbatim; evidence-only
frozen_expectations.L2_index_state: index answer recorded verbatim per row; index down/slow => local checks proceed with index:unavailable on receipt (README) — recorded, never verdict-affecting
